import { createButton } from "@starwind-ui/runtime/button";
import { ref, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, watch } from "vue";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    disabled?: boolean;
    focusableWhenDisabled?: boolean;
    type?: "button" | "submit" | "reset";
  }>(),
  { disabled: false, focusableWhenDisabled: false, type: "button" },
);
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();
const rootRef = ref<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
defineExpose({ element: rootRef });

let owned: ReturnType<typeof createButton> | undefined;
function dispose() {
  const previous = owned;
  owned = undefined;
  previous?.destroy();
}
function connect() {
  dispose();
  const element = rootRef.value;
  if (!element || !props["focusableWhenDisabled"]) return;
  owned = createButton(element, { disabled: props["disabled"] });
}
onMounted(connect);
onBeforeUnmount(dispose);
watch(() => props["focusableWhenDisabled"], connect, { flush: "post" });
watch(
  [() => props["disabled"]],
  () => {
    owned?.setDisabled(props["disabled"]);
  },
  { flush: "post" },
);
</script>

  <button
    v-bind="$attrs"
    :data-sw-button="''"

    :data-disabled="props['disabled'] ? '' : undefined"
    :aria-disabled="props['disabled'] && props['focusableWhenDisabled'] ? 'true' : undefined"

  type FormValidationTiming,
  type FormOptions,

} from "@starwind-ui/runtime/form";

  options?: FormOptions;

}>();
defineSlots<{
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
const configured = { options: false, errors: false };
const rootRef = ref<HTMLFormElement | null>(null);
let instance: ReturnType<typeof createForm> | undefined;

defineExpose({
  element: rootRef,
});

function destroyOwnedInstance(): void {
  const ownedInstance = instance;
  if (!ownedInstance) return;
  if (instance === ownedInstance) instance = undefined;
  ownedInstance.destroy();
}

onMounted(() => {
  const element = rootRef.value;
  if (!element) throw new Error("Form requires its native form before Runtime setup.");

  instance = createForm(element);
  watch(
    () => props.options,
    (options) => {
      if (instance) {
        if (options !== undefined || configured.options) {
          configured.options = options !== undefined;

            fieldValidators: undefined,
            formValidators: undefined,
            asyncFieldValidators: undefined,
            asyncFormValidators: undefined,
            asyncValidationDebounceMs: undefined,
            externalErrorsOnReset: undefined,
            onSubmit: undefined,
            ...options,

    },
    { immediate: true, flush: "post" },
  );
  watch(
    () => [props.errors, props.errorOptions] as const,
    ([errors, errorOptions]) => {
      if (instance) {
        if (errors !== undefined || configured.errors) {
          configured.errors = errors !== undefined;
          instance.setExternalErrors(errors ?? {}, errorOptions);

    },
